verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Claude Code follows the Unix philosophy: you can pipe logs into it, run it in CI, or chain it with other tools. They also document GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD automation, scheduled recurring runs, API-key auth that skips the login prompt, and the Agent SDK for programmatic orchestration. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation in the pack of the headless/print-mode flag, output formats or permission handling for unattended runs, and no independent hands-on corroboration of scripted use.
